examples.chinese: 我弟弟喜歡打棒球，我想送他一個棒球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuān dǎ bàngqiú, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge bàngqiú.
examples.english: My younger brother likes playing baseball, I’d like to give him a baseball as a gift.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

items.wordHook: 棒(stick) + 球(ball) → a stick hits the ball, that's baseball.

examples.chinese: 我不懂他的意思，不知道應該說什麼，所以有點兒緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng tā de yìsi, bù zhīdào yīnggāi shuō shénme, suǒyǐ yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: I don't understand what he means and don't know what I should say, so I am a bit nervous.

examples.chinese:
明天要考試，每個學生都很緊張。
今天的考試不難，大家都考得不錯。
examples.pinyin:
Míngtiān yào kǎoshì, měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
Jīntiān de kǎoshì bù nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de búcuò.
examples.english:
There will be an exam tomorrow, so every student is very nervous.
Today's exam was not difficult; everyone did pretty well on the test.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 今天中文口試時我太緊張了，一時不知道怎麼回答，所以成績不太好。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Zhōngwén kǒushì shí wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, yīshí bù zhīdào zěnme huídá, suǒyǐ chéngjī bù tài hǎo.
examples.english: During the Chinese oral exam today, I was too nervous and for a moment didn't know how to answer, so my grade wasn't very good.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese:
我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。
經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī.
Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english:
My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of.
The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese:
弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。
為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin:
Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo.
Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english:
Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night.
In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

items.wordHook: 緊(tight) + 張(stretched) → your body feels tight and stretched when nervous.

examples.chinese:
中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。
小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu.
Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english:
The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together.
Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 蛋黃月餅的營養豐富，可是不能多吃，不然很容易發胖。
examples.pinyin: Dànhuáng yuèbǐng de yíngyǎng fēngfù, kěshì bùnéng duō chī, bùrán hěn róngyì fāpàng.
examples.english: Egg yolk mooncakes are rich in nutrition, but you can't eat too many, otherwise you'll easily gain weight.

examples.chinese: 如果你希望有豐富的知識，就應該用功讀書。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xīwàng yǒu fēngfù de zhīshì, jiù yīnggāi yònggōng dúshū.
examples.english: If you hope to have abundant knowledge, you should study hard.

examples.chinese: 多閱讀書報、雜誌，能讓我們的知識更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Duō yuèdú shūbào, zázhì, néng ràng wǒmen de zhīshì gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: Reading more books, newspapers, and magazines can make our knowledge richer.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 在學習新知識的過程中，總是會有開心與煩惱的時候。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí xīn zhīshì de guòchéng zhōng, zǒngshì huì yǒu kāixīn yǔ fánnǎo de shíhou.
examples.english: In the process of learning new knowledge, there will always be times of happiness and worry.

examples.chinese: 教授學生做人的道理與教授知識同樣重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu xuéshēng zuòrén de dàolǐ yǔ jiàoshòu zhīshì tóngyàng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Instructing students in the principles of how to conduct themselves is just as important as instructing them in knowledge.

examples.chinese: 說實話，文憑不是最重要的，重要的是個人的知識與才能。
examples.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wénpíng bù shì zuì zhòngyào de, zhòngyào de shì gèrén de zhīshì yǔ cáinéng.
examples.english: To be honest, a diploma is not the most important thing; what is important is a person's knowledge and ability.

examples.chinese: A:聽說王先生有很多女朋友？ B:真的嗎？我不信他是這種人。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Wáng xiānsheng yǒu hěn duō nǚpéngyou? B: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ bú xìn tā shì zhè zhǒng rén.
examples.english: A: I heard Mr. Wang has many girlfriends? B: Really? I don't believe he is that kind of person.

examples.chinese: 他說的話不一定是真的，你別相信他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà bù yīdìng shì zhēn de, nǐ bié xiāngxìn tā.
examples.english: What he says isn't necessarily true—don't believe him.

examples.chinese: 大學給我一封正式的信，通知我得到獎學金了。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué gěi wǒ yì fēng zhèngshì de xìn, tōngzhī wǒ dédào jiǎngxuéjīn le.
examples.english: The university gave me a formal letter notifying me that I have received a scholarship.

examples.chinese: 我相信有專業能力就比較容易找到好工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn yǒu zhuānyè nénglì jiù bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
examples.english: I believe that if you have professional ability, it is relatively easy to find a good job.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 我寫信給父母，跟他們說我在台灣很安全，請他們放心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiě xìn gěi fùmǔ, gēn tāmen shuō wǒ zài Táiwān hěn ānquán, qǐng tāmen fàngxīn.
examples.english: I wrote a letter to my parents, telling them that I am very safe in Taiwan and asking them to rest assured.

examples.chinese: 他昨天去逛夜市的時候，信用卡被偷了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān qù guàng yèshì de shíhou, xìnyòngkǎ bèi tōu le.
examples.english: When he went to the night market yesterday, his credit card was stolen.

examples.chinese: 我常常用中文給台灣朋友寫信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng yòng Zhōngwén gěi Táiwān péngyǒu xiě xìn.
examples.english: I often write letters to Taiwanese friends in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 我要到郵局去寄信，也要買一些信封。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào yóujú qù jì xìn, yě yào mǎi yīxiē xìnfēng.
examples.english: I want to go to the post office to mail a letter, and also buy some envelopes.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese:
付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。
他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin:
Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán.
Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english:
When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk.
He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese:
我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。
A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá.
A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english:
I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately.
A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese:
沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。
不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin:
Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi.
Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english:
No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well.
Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese:
我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。
經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī.
Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english:
My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of.
The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 有人信上帝，有人不信。但在東西方的文化中，「上帝」的角色都是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xìn Shàngdì, yǒu rén bú xìn. Dàn zài dōng xīfāng de wénhuà zhōng, “Shàngdì” de juésè dōu shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Some people believe in God, and some do not. But in both Eastern and Western cultures, the role of “God” is very important.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 有人說，這個世界是上帝創造的，你相信嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒurén shuō, zhège shìjiè shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de, nǐ xiāngxìn ma?
examples.english: Some people say that this world was created by God; do you believe it?

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。
examples.pinyin: Dàxìn juéde zhège gōngsī de xīnshuǐ gēn fúlì dōu bù hǎo, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Daxin felt that this company's salary and benefits were both bad, so he decided to change jobs.

examples.chinese: 收到別人的信時，應該回信告訴對方收到了，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào biérén de xìn shí, yīnggāi huíxìn gàosu duìfāng shōudào le, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: When you receive a letter from someone, you should write back to tell the other person that you have received it; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tuìxiū le, bùguò hái shícháng gēn jǐ wèi yàohǎo de tóngshì tōngxìn.
examples.english: I have already retired, but I still often correspond with a few close colleagues.

examples.chinese: 前天我收到大學的來信，才知道我被錄取了，真開心。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān wǒ shōudào dàxué de láixìn, cái zhīdào wǒ bèi lùqǔ le, zhēn kāixīn.
examples.english: The day before yesterday I received an incoming letter from the university, and only then did I learn that I had been admitted; I'm really happy.

examples.chinese: 寄掛號信雖然貴了一點兒，可是比較可靠。
examples.pinyin: Jì guàhàoxìn suīrán guì le yīdiǎnr, kěshì bǐjiào kěkào.
examples.english: Although sending a registered letter is a bit more expensive, it is more reliable.

examples.chinese: 人人都有屬於自己的長處，要對自己更有信心。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de chángchù, yào duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; you should have more confidence in yourself.

examples.chinese: 答應別人的事就要做到，這才是有信用的人。
examples.pinyin: Dāying biérén de shì jiù yào zuòdào, zhè cái shì yǒu xìnyòng de rén.
examples.english: When you agree to do something for someone, you must do it—only then are you a person with credit.

examples.chinese: 國外旅行時隨時攜帶護照、信用卡，可讓你玩得安心又順利。
examples.pinyin: Guówài lǚxíng shí suíshí xiédài hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, kě ràng nǐ wán de ānxīn yòu shùnlì.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, carrying your passport and credit card at all times can let you have fun with peace of mind and smoothly.

examples.chinese: 刷卡買東西很方便，用讀卡機器刷一下信用卡就能付錢了。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ mǎi dōngxī hěn fāngbiàn, yòng dúkǎ jīqì shuā yīxià xìnyòngkǎ jiù néng fù qián le.
examples.english: Using a credit card to buy things is very convenient; with a card reader, you just swipe the credit card once and you can pay.

examples.chinese: 信用卡的正面和背面都有一組號碼，在線上刷卡時用得到。
examples.pinyin: Xìnyòngkǎ de zhèngmiàn hé bèimiàn dōu yǒu yī zǔ hàomǎ, zài xiànshàng shuākǎ shí yòng de dào.
examples.english: Both the front side and the back of a credit card have a set of numbers; they are used when swiping the card online.

examples.chinese: 在表演以前準備得越多，上舞臺就越有自信。
examples.pinyin: Zài biǎoyǎn yǐqián zhǔnbèi de yuè duō, shàng wǔtái jiù yuè yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: The more you prepare before a performance, the more confident you will be when you go on stage.

examples.chinese: 假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú shīqù le rénmín de xìnxīn yǔ zhīchí, guójiā yě huì biàn de bù āndìng.
examples.english: If it loses the people's confidence and support, the country will also become unstable.

examples.chinese: 經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng duàn bùxìng de gǎnqíng shēnghuó, nà wèi nǚshì duì àiqíng yǐ shīqù le xìnxīn.
examples.english: After two unfortunate romantic relationships, that lady has already lost confidence in love.

examples.chinese: 我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu shì xìn Jīdūjiào de, bùlùn jiàohuì jǔbàn shénme huódòng, wǒmen dōu yīdìng qù cānjiā.
examples.english: Our whole family is Christian; no matter what activities the church holds, we always go to participate.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu péngyǒu yǔ jiārén de gǔlì, shǐ tā zài miànduì rènhé kùnnán shí dōu shífēn zìxìn.
examples.english: With the encouragement of friends and family, he is very confident when facing any difficulty.

examples.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
examples.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

examples.chinese: 迷信的人老是相信一些不真實的迷信，例如：黑貓會帶來不好的運氣、送傘給情人就會分手什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Míxìn de rén lǎoshì xiāngxìn yīxiē bù zhēnshí de míxìn, lìrú: hēimāo huì dàilái bù hǎo de yùnqì, sòng sǎn gěi qíngrén jiù huì fēnshǒu shénme de.
examples.english: Superstitious people always believe in some untrue superstitions, for example: black cats will bring bad luck, giving an umbrella to a lover will lead to a breakup, and so on.

examples.chinese: 情侶之間如果無法相信彼此，很容易就分手了。
examples.pinyin: Qínglǚ zhījiān rúguǒ wúfǎ xiāngxìn bǐcǐ, hěn róngyì jiù fēnshǒu le.
examples.english: If couples cannot trust each other, they easily break up.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) puts their 言(speech) on paper and sends it → a 信(letter) to a friend.

examples.chinese:
我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。
A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá.
A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english:
I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately.
A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

items.wordHook: Combining 要(essential) and 緊(tight): 要緊 means important.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: 下週五有上百位家長會到我們學校，一同參加全校運動會。
examples.pinyin: Xià zhōuwǔ yǒu shàngbǎi wèi jiāzhǎng huì dào wǒmen xuéxiào, yìtóng cānjiā quánxiào yùndònghuì.
examples.english: Next Friday, hundreds of parents will come to our school to participate together in the whole-school sports meet.

items.wordHook: Combining 家(family) and 長(grow): 家長 means parent.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese:
外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。
那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin:
Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù.
Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english:
During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance.
That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 不少人利用新年期間到國外旅行，國內過年的氣氛就越來越淡了。
examples.pinyin: Bù shǎo rén lìyòng xīnnián qījiān dào guówài lǚxíng, guónèi guònián de qìfēn jiù yuèláiyuè dàn le.
examples.english: Many people take advantage of the New Year period to travel abroad, so the atmosphere of celebrating the New Year domestically is becoming weaker and weaker.

examples.chinese: 以前人們常用磁帶來存電腦的重要資料。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián rénmen cháng yòng cídài lái cún diànnǎo de zhòngyào zīliào.
examples.english: In the past, people often used magnetic tape to store important computer data.

examples.chinese: 史小姐到花蓮來觀光時不小心迷了路，幸虧遇到了熱心的阿姨送她回旅館。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě dào Huālián lái guānguāng shí bù xiǎoxīn mí le lù, xìngkuī yùdào le rèxīn de āyí sòng tā huí lǚguǎn.
examples.english: When Miss Shi came to Hualien for sightseeing, she accidentally got lost; fortunately, she met a warmhearted auntie who took her back to the hotel.

items.wordHook: A strong 扌(hand) pulls the boundary ropes outward into a 廣(broad) territory to steadily 擴(expand).
一(one) 日(sun) 乂(cross) mark rests on the dial → the night 更(even) colder.
A 十(ten) pins a 且(qiě) board flat, and an 一(one) line runs down it dead straight → 直(straight).
